newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stocks follow Dow higher at open.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks follow Dow higher at open.

text.p: Australian shares followed Wall Street higher at the opening on Tuesday, with big banks leading the way as they continued to regain Friday's lost ground.
From the opening, the All Ordinaries index added 19.1 points to 2,358.9.
Brokers said the rebound in the Dow had heartened local investors who again jumped into the high-yielding bank sector in moderate numbers.

"It's all been on the back of the Dow this morning," said a Sydney broker, pointing to the outperforming banks and finance index. "The banks are impressive again and bonds are a little firmer which is helping."
The banks and finance sector made early gains of over one percent, compared to a gain in the benchmark All Ordinaries index of about 0.8 percent.
Rises outnumbered falls by a ratio of about nine to two, while about 35 percent of stocks traded remained steady.
